title: Symbol Demodulator
text: Demodulate complex constellation symbol to set of LLR values or data bits, 5 inputs, 4 outputs, {Modulation} sets Modulation type; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation, {Maximum modulation}, {Constellation ordering}, {Constellation mapping}, {Decision type} sets the type of demapping Approximate log-likelihood, {Phase offset}, {Output type} sets the type of output, {Normalization method} scales signal constellation Unit average, {Minimum distance between symbols} and {Enable noise variance input port} sets the option to enable noise variance port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Data symbols real-valued scalar | complex-valued scalar

ports.summary: Control signals accompanying sample stream samplecontrol bus

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: Source for modulation type Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Constellation mapping
params.values: Constellation mapping [2, 3, 1, 0, 6, 7, 5, 4, 14, 15, 13, 12, 10, 11, 9, 8] (default) | unique integer-valued gray-coded row vector

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Type of demapping Approximate log-likelihood ratio (default) | Hard

params.name: Phase offset
params.values: Phase offset for constellation points pi/2 (default) | pi/4 | pi/8 | pi/16 | pi/32 | 0 | -pi/32 | -pi/16 | -pi/8 | -pi/4 | -pi/2

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: Scale signal constellation Unit average power (default) | Custom

params.name: Minimum distance between symbols
params.values: Minimum distance between symbols 2 (default) | values in the range from 1/32 to 2

params.name: Enable noise variance input port
params.values: Option to enable noise variance port off (default) | on
